description.description: Pure visual identity of the actor: species/anthropomorphic form, build, face, distinctive features, clothing, colours, posture. NO setting, NO emotion, NO dialogue.

setting.description: This character's OWN location/background: the room or environment they appear in, props, lighting, mood. One character per setting.

line.description: The EXACT spoken line, copied VERBATIM from the script in its original native script. Do not translate, paraphrase, shorten, romanize or 'clean up'.

emotion.description: The performance / delivery for this line (e.g. 'cold, predatory'; 'manic, hysterical laugh'; 'smug, untouchable').

sfx.description: Optional sound-effect cues for this beat (e.g. 'paper tearing, distant thunder').
